metadata.name: program
metadata.description: the worksheet program marker. sheetapp is the origin-application its documents (origin-user segments stamped applications:["sheetapp"]) render against; it owns new/open/save/load/close + the worksheet window render (sheetdoc). role:application is derived from the application/ loader group.

metadata.name: sheetdoc
metadata.description: (state, seg, title?, offset?) - open a worksheet window over the cels of document segment `seg`, rendered via the sheets segment's sheetgrid (reactive: the content formula references each grid cel). The window (program) is win.<seg>; the data stays in segment <seg>. Idempotent (re-open un-hides + raises).

metadata.name: origin.opendoc
metadata.description: (state, name) - open a sheetapp DOCUMENT: loadUserSpace the origin-user segment from the store (hydrates both its parent app + its own cels), then render it as worksheet window(s) (sheetdoc). The launcher path for a recorded document (doc:<name>).

metadata.name: origin.newsheet
metadata.description: (state) - the Sheet app: create a fresh blank worksheet DOCUMENT (a new origin-user segment of sheetapp), seed an empty grid, and render it. Save with origin.savedoc.
